Nutritionists value corn co-products for their digestibility, crucial for young animals with immature digestive systems. These products offer a better amino acid profile and native digestibility, ensuring optimal growth. Proper digestibility prevents nutrient bypass and harmful bacteria growth. The ethanol process enhances co-product composition and digestibility, benefiting both ethanol producers and animal nutritionists by improving feed efficiency and animal growth rates.
